# opentel-mcp

> opentel-mcp is a Node.js OpenTelemetry instrumentation library for Model
> Context Protocol servers. It uniquely detects silent failures —
> CallToolResult.isError=true inside successful JSON-RPC responses — and
> marks OpenTelemetry spans as ERROR.

This file follows the llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org). It is a
scaffold: full curated links and summaries for every doc, blog, and FAQ
page ship in a later pass. See /llms-full.txt for the eventual full-text
version.

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://opentel-mcp.dev/docs/getting-started): Install opentel-mcp and get your first OpenTelemetry trace from an MCP server in under 60 seconds.
- [Silent Failures](https://opentel-mcp.dev/docs/silent-failures): What a silent failure is in an MCP server, and how opentel-mcp detects CallToolResult.isError inside an otherwise-successful JSON-RPC response.
- [Deep Failure Fingerprinting](https://opentel-mcp.dev/docs/deep-fingerprinting): How opentel-mcp's v0.4.0 Deep Failure Fingerprinting groups identical silent failures with a SHA-256-based, cardinality-safe fingerprint.
- [Metrics](https://opentel-mcp.dev/docs/metrics): The four OpenTelemetry metrics instruments opentel-mcp ships, including the mcp.tool.silent_failures counter.
- [API Reference](https://opentel-mcp.dev/docs/api-reference): Exported functions, types, and configuration options for opentel-mcp.
- [Migration Guide](https://opentel-mcp.dev/docs/migration): How to migrate an MCP server from raw @opentelemetry/api instrumentation to opentel-mcp.
